findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "reserve_sandbox_verify_outcome" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Test separate reviewer credentials on fictional data only.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "reserve_describe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "One-call discovery: real offer catalog, $0 quote, tools and current limitations." → after: "One-call discovery: offer catalog, the free quote, the paid Reserve Pass, tools and limits."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
